resolutions.phrase: The one-third restock threshold from the 1 October call stays for every shelf except oats and rice, which now restock at half full.

referents.why: Dario's 1 October rule ('any shelf when it falls below a third full') is kept for most shelves and gets an exception for oats and rice at half full. That adds a consequence to the rule and does not replace it.
'The 1 October call' names this transcript as the origin of the threshold, without engaging its other content.

resolutions.why: The one-third pantry threshold from the 1 October call matches a single expression, the pantry rule in Position_NovemberFirstOperatingChanges. It is the most specific leaf, and nothing else in the graph mentions restock thresholds.
